name: 陳聿寬
objective:
本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調設計與人文專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
This course aims to provide pre-service design and cultural business students / professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.
課程進度(1-16週):
Tentative Outline
Week 1:  Course Orientation & Diagnostic Test 
Week 2:  Course Orientation & Diagnostic Test 
Week 3:  Discussion on students' learning difficulties.
Week 4:  Self-Introduction (Oral Presentation)
Week 5:  Revision Exercise: Listening 1
Week 6:  Revision Exercise: Listening 2
Week 7:  Discussion and Speaking Exercise
Week 8:  Unit 1: Preview and Discussion
Week 9:  Reading and Listening Exercises
Week 10: Unit 2: Preview and Discussion
Week 11: Reading and Listening Exercises
Week 12: Unit 3: Preview and Discussion
Week 13: Reading and Listening Exercises
Week 14: Unit 4: Preview and Discussion
Week 15: Reading and Listening Exercises
Week 16: Final Exam
Week 17: 彈性學習週 (Project Research and Discussion)
Week 18: 彈性學習週 (Online or Recorded Oral Report)

附註：開學上課時，老師會依據同學學習能力跟進度調整大綱內容。
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          In WEEK 17-18, students are expected to first conduct research on an assigned topic and / or research question in relation to the course content. Then, complete the research report in the form of PPT slides with an oral presentation (depending on the circumstances, the presentation will be delivered either as a recording or on a one-to-one basis with the instructor).
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Submit the research report (in the form of PPT slides) with an oral presentation.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          Research Report and Oral Report: 10%

本課程為專業英文（ESP/EAP）中級班課程，教材、講義及簡報均採全英文；課堂授課及師生互動之英語使用比例 70~80% (含) 以上。
consultation: 選課同學可留意本頁面並定期查詢北科 i 學園 (iStudy) 公告欄以了解課程內容與進度。平時下課時間，或者課後亦可與老師以 email: ykchen@ntut.edu.tw 進行課程討論與溝通。Regularly checking announcements on the iStudy bulletin board is strongly advised for this class.
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG3：良好健康和福祉（Good Health and Well-being）SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG5：性別平等（Gender Equality）SDG10：減少不平等（Reduced Inequalities）SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）SDG16：和平正義與有力的制度（Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions）SDG17：夥伴關係（Partnerships for the Goals）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）
remarks: 歡迎同學修讀本課程，若遇疫情或不可抗力因素無法於學校進行實體教學，以學校公布遠距教學規則為準。原則上會以 Google Meet 進行遠距教學模式（北科同學們的學校帳號都會連結ㄧ個 gmail 帳號，有此帳號即可到上課時間時，可依據老師於此欄位，或者同步於班級 LINE 群組公布的代碼連結加入課程）。
